oneLine: Bonfiglioli Transmissions is in the news regarding potential IPO plans.

sources.title: Can Bonfiglioli Transmissions IPO deliver long-term growth for high-risk investors?

synopsis: Bonfiglioli Transmissions is planning an initial public offering to raise Rs2,534 crore through an offer for sale. The promoter group, headquartered in Italy and known as Bonfiglioli S.p.A., will see its stake reduce from 100% to 77% post-IPO. The company manufactures high-precision gearboxes and drive systems, catering to sectors such as industrial automation, construction, mining, material handling, and wind energy. Between 2023 and 2025, revenue from operations increased annually to Rs2,013.5 crore, while net profit grew to Rs237.9 crore in 2025. In the six months leading to June 2026, revenue and net profit continued to increase year-on-year. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra, and pays a royalty to its promoter group for intellectual property and brand usage.
